scheme_name: Educational Assistance to Children of Women Headed Families
other_conditions: Only two children per family are eligible for the scheme
The child must study in a Government or Government‑aided school or college
Women belonging to Below Poverty Line families are eligible
HIV/AIDS‑affected persons, socially discriminated persons, war widows, etc., are eligible irrespective of BPL status
A family where the husband is bedridden due to stroke or spinal injury is eligible
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹300–₹1,000 per month is provided to children based on their educational level, from primary school up to degree courses.
